question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution: The correct answer is '**reduced**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**reduced**'. • It means 'to make something less or smaller in quantity, price, size, etc.' (मात्रा, क़ीमत, आकार आदि की दृष्टि से घटाना; छोटा करना) • *Example: The sign said ‘**Reduce** speed now’.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Passage:__** *New cycle routes have been built in and around the centre of Birmingham and speed limits have been **reduced** on selected roads. The scheme has now been in (2) ______ for a year and has been hailed as a (3) ______ success. Since the new speed limits were (4) ______, the number of accidents in the area have fallen (5) ______*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words • **​shortened**: to become shorter or to make something shorter. (छोटा हो जाना या कर देना • **lessened**: to become less; to make something less. (कम हो जाना; कम कर देना • **scaled**: to climb up a high wall, steep cliff, etc. (ऊँची दीवार या खड़ी चट्टान आदि पर चढ़ना) 43:Tc9f, The correct answer is '**operation**'.
